catalog_quote: p.3: 苗语具备汉藏语系语言的一般特点：1.每个音节都有声调，这个声调使它跟其他同声母同韵母的音节区别意义。2.语音的结合有较大的局限性，例如只有一定的辅音可以居于音节末尾。3.每个音节差不多都有词汇意义或语法意义，多音节的单纯词不多。另外，苗语的声调系统和汉语完全相同。 ... p.105: 4.惠水次方言 (1)北部土语 使用人数约有五万。通行在贵州省贵阳市高坡，惠水县羊场，贵定县塘堡、平伐等地。(2)西南土语 使用人数约有四万。通行在贵州省惠水县雅水、三都、斗底、断杉，长顺县摆塘、中果等地。

new_statements.quote: p.3: 苗语具备汉藏语系语言的一般特点: 1. 每个音节都有声调，这个声调使它跟其他同声母同韵母的音节区别意义。2. 语音的结合有较大的局限性，例如只有一定的辅音可以居于音节末尾。3. 每个音节差不多都有词汇意义或语法意义，多音节的单纯词不多。 … p.105: 4. 惠水次方言 … (2) 西南土语 使用人数约有四万。通行在贵州省惠水县雅水、三都、斗底、断杉，长顺县摆塘、中果等地。
new_statements.translation: p.3: Miao has the general characteristics of Sino-Tibetan languages: 1. every syllable has a tone, and this tone distinguishes it in meaning from other syllables with the same initial and final; 2. the combination of sounds is rather restricted, e.g. only certain consonants may stand at the end of a syllable; 3. almost every syllable has lexical or grammatical meaning; polysyllabic simple words are few. … p.105: 4. Huishui sub-dialect … (2) Southwestern vernacular: about 40,000 speakers, spoken in Yashui, Sandu, Doudi and Duanshan of Huishui County and Baitang, Zhongguo of Changshun County, Guizhou.
new_statements.citation: Wang Fushi 王辅世 (主编). 1985. 苗语简志 Miaoyu jianzhi [A sketch of the Miao language]. Beijing: 民族出版社.
new_statements.locator: p.3 (general characteristics of Miao) and p.105 (方言 chapter, 4. 惠水次方言 (2) 西南土语)
new_statements.second_reader_evidence: Opened the two page renders saved for this key and, from the scan we hold, archive.org, 210 pp). p.3 reads exactly '苗语具备汉藏语系语言的一般特点：1.每个音节都有声调，这个声调使它跟其他同声母同韵母的音节区别意义。2.语音的结合有较大的局限性，例如只有一定的辅音可以居于音节末尾。3.每个音节差不多都有词汇意义或语法意义，多音节的单纯词不多。' and p.105 reads exactly '4.惠水次方言 (1) 北部土语.. (2) 西南土语 使用人数约有四万。通行在贵州省惠水县雅水、三都、斗底、断杉，长顺县摆塘、中果等地。' -- both quotes verbatim (the ellipses in the report only skip intervening text). Read the surrounding material in the scanned : the phonology chapter (ch.1) explicitly takes 腊乙坪 (Xiangxi), 养蒿 (Qiandong) and 大南山 (Chuanqiandian) as its three points (lines 527-587, 1070, 1492); the only 轻声 passage (p.12, the scanned text: '连读变调不明显，在合成词或四音格中前加成分往往读作轻声。特别是前加成分 qo35、ta35、te3…
new_statements.rule_in_words: The source characterises Miao as a whole (explicitly including the Huishui sub-dialect and its Southwestern vernacular in its classification) as a syllable-tone language; it gives no phonology of the Southwestern Huishui vernacular and makes no statement about word stress for it (its only 轻声 'light/unstressed' remark, p.12, concerns prefixes in Layiping = Western Xiangxi Miao).
new_statements.domain_note: Language-wide (all Miao) tonal characterisation, not specific to sout2755; Wang's own phonology chapter treats Dananshan (Chuanqiandian) only. No first-hand phonological description of Southwestern Huishui was accessible.
new_statements.identity_note: sout2755 = 苗语川黔滇方言惠水次方言西南土语 (Wang 1985 p.105: Yashui 雅水, Sandu 三都, Doudi 斗底, Duanshan 断杉 in Huishui County; Baitang 摆塘, Zhongguo 中果 in Changshun). Li Yunbing 2000/2018 call it the 'Western' Huishui tuyu with representative point Yarong 鸭绒乡, Huishui (per en.wikipedia's rendering of Li 2018). Note a 1994 贵州民族语文研究集 snippet uses a different local scheme in which 鸭寨/鸭绒/雅水/斗底 are called the 'Central' tuyu -- naming of the Huishui tuyu is not uniform across Chinese sources. The only statement quoted (Wang 1985 p.3) is a language-wide characterisation of Miao, not specific to this vernacular; sibling checks for cent2013 (Central Huishui), nort2749 (Northern Huishui) and chua1256 reached the same silence.
